The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.

Regarding the effectiveness of the encryption methods mentioned in the paragraph: The text describes the implementation of AES-256 bit encryption. This assessment is accurate. AES-256 is currently considered one of the most secure encryption standards available. Its 256-bit key size creates a keyspace so vast that brute-force attacks are computationally infeasible with current technology. Therefore, the claim that it is "widely accepted as very secure and nearly impervious to brute-force attacks" is correct, and its use significantly enhances the confidentiality and integrity of stored or transmitted data.
